Facility Map

One fertigation core feeds six identical flower rooms. Each room is a live showcase for its sponsor's equipment, running under real growing conditions.

CORE / FERTIGATION

Fertigation Room

House System

The fertigation room is the facility's nutrient engine. Concentrated stock solutions are drawn down, precisely dosed, and blended before being pushed into batch tanks that refill and re-mix automatically as they draw down — keeping all six flower rooms fed on a consistent, unattended cycle.

1
Nutrient Mixer

Blends the base nutrient charge that feeds the concentration tanks.

2
Concentration Tanks

Hold stock nutrient solutions at supply strength, ready for dosing.

3
Dosatron Injectors

Ratio-controlled dosing pulls concentrate into the line with no electricity required.

4
Batch Tanks

Auto-refill and auto-remix on drawdown, supplying all six flower rooms without manual intervention.

// Fertigation Flow
Growth StageEC TargetBatch Refill Trigger
Vegetative3.0Tank < 30% full
Early Flower3.0Tank < 30% full
Late Flower (Push)3.0Tank < 30% full
